reason: I've been burned by a fake agency's 'registration fee' before, so I'm not paying a new beta app anything, even ₹499. If I try it at all it'll be the free first collab, and Auto-DM means handing over my Instagram, which I won't do yet.
objection: Giving an app access to my Instagram feels risky, and a small Bengaluru-only beta team could disappear, along with my 'customers I brought' record.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing creators from my WhatsApp groups actually get a cash collab off their Mitra counts, after a free collab where the café really used the coupon.
